title: Debut Pulse: Launch synchronization checklist for adding new model to catalog
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Coordinated GTM checklist and operational runway for adding a new open model variant to Redwood's Catalog. This ticket captures cross-team tasks (engineering readiness, benchmarks, docs, release notes, developer samples, comms), a press/partner kit, and the execution timeline needed to launch with predictable latency/cost messaging and clear rollback/fallback rules.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Model is listed in Catalog with metadata, pricing, and compatibility tags; 2) Benchmark matrix uploaded and approved by Applied ML; 3) Console tile and route created with telemetry enabled; 4) Release notes and developer quickstart published; 5) Cross-team launch playback completed and signoffs collected from Eng, Design, Security, and Support.
checklist: Finalize model metadata (name, tags, compatible runtimes, quantization notes)
Approve benchmark set and test harness (latency, throughput, quality on 6 query families)
Create console product tile and toggle (preview vs GA)
Prepare SDK sample (Node/Python) and one-shot demo app
Draft release notes and feature brief for docs site
Assemble press/partner kit and one-pager for sales
Schedule launch replay with on-call and support
Run security checklist and KMS/HSM integration validation
Create alerting thresholds and cost guardrails for hosted offering
Define rollback triggers and fallback model mapping
comms_plan: 1) Internal launch playbook sent to All-Eng + GTM one business day before GA. 2) Release notes posted to docs.redwood.ai and emailed to developer beta list. 3) Blog post coordinated with Marketing on GA day with benchmark highlights and cost comparison table. 4) Partner brief and technical FAQ to reseller partners. 5) Social amplification with two example snippets and sample app link.
release_notes_draft: Headline: Added <ModelX-1.0> to the Redwood Catalog — faster latency at competitive cost. Summary: ModelX-1.0 is a compact transformer tuned for low-latency interactive workloads. Highlights: 35% lower median latency on short prompts vs baseline, official SDK samples, and a new console preview tile. Breaking changes: none. Migration notes: use "model: modelx-1.0" in requests; legacy model aliases still available for 30 days.
benchmarks_plan: Bench harness: public benchmark repo link; Query families: chat, summarization, code-completion, retrieval-augmented generation, instruction-following, embeddings consistency. Metrics: P50/P95 latency, throughput at 1–16 concurrency, per-token compute cost estimate, qualitative evals (BLEU/ROUGE/MT-BERTscore as appropriate). Run baseline vs rtx-40/amp and quantized int8 variants. Deliverable: benchmark matrix CSV and visualization for console.
launch_timeline: 2026-02-22: Final metadata locked. 2026-02-24: Benchmarks run (first pass). 2026-02-28: Console tile stage deployed. 2026-03-03: Docs and sample SDK uploaded to staging. 2026-03-10: Cross-team dress rehearsal and signoffs. 2026-03-15: GA announcement and release notes publish.
post_launch_metrics: Adoption: model selection rate vs catalog average; Latency: P50/P95 for first 72 hrs; Cost: USD per 1k tokens; Errors: rate of 5xx/4xx per route; Customer feedback notes from Support; Rollback windows and frequency.
rollout_strategy: Phased rollout: start with preview flag for 10% of new requests, expand to 50% after 48h with no regressions, then GA at 100% after 7 days. Route-specific enablement for Dedicated and Private customers with opt-in. Automatic downgrade mapping to closest compatible model on capacity or SLA violation.
rollback_plan: Trigger conditions: +20% latency P95 over baseline, error rate >1% sustained for 30m, catastrophic quality regression detected by eval suite. Rollback action: flip preview flag off, route traffic to fallback model alias, notify on-call, and open incident in Statuspage. Follow-up: postmortem and corrective actions within 7 days.
qa_tests: Unit tests for model metadata parsing, integration test for SDK examples, smoke tests for console tile and telemetry ingestion, end-to-end sample app verification, benchmark reproducibility check, security scan for dependency vulnerabilities.
